data.narrative:
Cellcolabs is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Mattias Bernow that has raised $37M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three valuation methods tested, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This method uses the company's $37M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression to the next financing stage, yielding $74M. The Peer-Median approach was not viable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum thresholds (0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage peer identified). Public-Comp Anchoring could not be executed because Cellcolabs' revenue is not on file, as is standard for private companies; the public set's 6.2x median P/S ratio thus cannot be applied.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $63M to $85M, with a median of $74M. This range reflects the methodological constraint of relying on a single applicable technique. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue visibility for comparable-multiple triangulation and the limited number of truly proximate private peer transactions at identical stage and profile.
